summary: HDFC Bank furnished a 6-K reporting that India's RBI approved Anup Bagchi as Managing Director & CEO for a three-year term effective October 27, 2026, succeeding Sashidhar Jagdishan; the board named him an Additional Director from October 2, 2026, subject to shareholder approval. Bagchi, formerly ICICI Prudential Life CEO and ICICI Bank Executive Director, receives RBI-approved remuneration. The filing is a routine foreign-private-issuer current report (US equivalent of a Form 8-K) on a planned, regulator-approved leadership succession, not an abrupt forced departure, so it is classified as a non-special-situation disclosure with no deal terms and minimal market-structure implications.
